comment: Gap in architecture: Laboratory information systems, Blood bank/ blood safety systems, biomedical and cold chain equipment, and One Health. In particular, DPI-H presents an opportunity to critically appraise national availability of data from outside the formal "health sector", such as animal and plant health, in a One Health framework.
